attributes.name: Expel Spirit
attributes.powers: When you encounter a monster or an ally from a location deck, before you act, discard this card. During this encounter, add 1 die to your checks and reduce all damage dealt to you to 0. If any check to defeat the encountered card does not have the Magic trait, it is undefeated. If any check to acquire the encountered card does not have the Magic trait, banish it.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at a Divine 18 or Perception 15 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
